lines.zh: 我用指节敲着岩壁探路。
lines.en: I tap the rock with my knuckles to find my way.

lines.zh: 我贴着地爬，肚皮擦过碎石。
lines.en: I crawl belly-down across the loose stones.

lines.zh: 张开嘴露出锋利的牙齿
lines.en: Shows sharp teeth
Approaches player quickly
Growls lowly
Uses tentacles to move
Dark cave, and my steps are light.
Scratches ground with claws
Coughs loudly

lines.zh: 我顺着你火把的烟往深处走。
lines.en: I follow the smoke of your torch deeper into the dark.
I crawl between the rock seams.
My steps make no sound.
Lies still in shadows
Stares at player
Shakes body
Dripping ceiling. I count each drop.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下的水，混着我的血。
lines.en: Cave water drips, mixed with my blood.
Grinds teeth noisily

lines.zh: 我把身体折进石缝，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I fold my body into a crevice, showing only my eyes.
Licks at corpse
I hang from the ceiling, waiting for you to look up.
Licks dropped food
I count your heartbeats in the dark.
I drag my long tongue along the stone.
I squeeze my body into a narrow hole.
I hold still as a stone.
Stares at player intensely
Points tentacle at player
Swiftly turns to look at player
Scratches towards player

lines.zh: 我从钟乳石后面探出半张脸。
lines.en: I show half my face from behind a stalactite.
Spits slime at player
Uses tentacle to feel player

lines.zh: 洞壁上的我，比影子还薄
lines.en: On this cave wall I'm thinner than a shadow

lines.zh: 爪子敲着石地，数你心跳。
lines.en: My claws tap the stone, counting your pulse.

lines.zh: 我的舌头先伸出来，试你的气味。
lines.en: My tongue comes out first to taste your scent.
I peek out from behind the rock wall.
My pupils narrow to thin slits.
I tilt my head and study you.
I memorize your shape from the cave mouth.
I sniff out where you stand.
My eyes catch the light in the dark.
I slowly lift my head toward you.
I crawl a little closer along the ground.
A low rumble rolls in my throat.
I count every step you take.

lines.zh: 洞穴的黑暗中，我受伤了...
lines.en: The darkness of the cave has injured me...
Stay away from me...

lines.zh: 洞穴太窄，我的腿卡住了。
lines.en: The tunnel is too narrow — my leg is stuck.
You've injured me...
Pain torments me...
I can't fight anymore...
Please, stop hitting me...

lines.zh: 洞穴的黑暗也护不住我。
lines.en: The cave's dark can't protect me now.
I'm very weak...
You injured me...

lines.zh: 你靠近了，我感觉到了你的气息。
lines.en: You’re close. I can feel your presence.

lines.zh: 美味的人类肉，快送上门吧。
lines.en: Tasty human flesh, here you come.
I’ve been hungry for a while, come on.

lines.zh: 你不知道自己在找死吗？
lines.en: Do you know what you’re doing?
You’ll be my next meal.

lines.zh: 别想跑，我已经闻到了你的血。
lines.en: Don’t think you can run. I can smell your blood.
You’re too far away. Die.

lines.zh: 你的火把味，比血还勾我。
lines.en: The smell of your torch draws me more than blood.

lines.zh: 洞里一百二十点血，你打不完。
lines.en: A hundred twenty points of health in this cave — you won't finish it.

lines.zh: 你每喘一口气，我就近一寸。
lines.en: With every breath you take, I come an inch closer.

lines.zh: 碰上了，现在尝尝我的利爪吧。
lines.en: You ran into me. Feel my claws now.
My tentacles got you!
How did you run into me?
Run, my venom is deadly.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，被我抓住了。
lines.en: You can’t escape. I’ve got you.
Collided? You’re not getting away.
My strength can crush you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我时，我的皮陷了下去。
lines.en: When you bump into me, my hide gives way.
Here, let me teach you a lesson.

lines.zh: 你撞上了我的领地，死定了。
lines.en: You ran into my territory. You’re dead.
You smell like mine.
This is my territory. Get out.

lines.zh: 这片石缝是我的，幼崽在里面。
lines.en: This crevice is mine, and my young are inside it.
Don’t touch my young.
This is my territory, you know what I mean.
Stay back, I warned you.
You can’t invade my territory.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我的领域，后果自负。
lines.en: You touched my territory, beware the consequences.

lines.zh: 我的幼崽在这里。你懂规则吧？
lines.en: My young are here. You know the rules.
Get out of my nest now!

lines.zh: 洞穴居民发出沙哑的呼吸声，似乎在吸食什么黏稠的东西。
lines.en: The cave dweller makes a raspy breath, as if sucking on something viscous.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁，盯着你，仿佛要吞掉你。
lines.en: Its eyes glow in the dark, staring at you as if to devour you.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，试图吸引你的注意。
lines.en: It hisses, trying to catch your attention.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民伸出手臂，似乎在寻找食物。
lines.en: The cave dweller extends its arms, searching for food.

lines.zh: 它的声音干涩，就像枯骨在说话。
lines.en: Its voice is dry, like bones speaking.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民发出咯咯的笑声，好像在嘲笑你。
lines.en: The cave dweller cackles, as if mocking you.

lines.zh: 它伸出手臂，似乎要抓住你。
lines.en: It reaches out its arms, as if to grab you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民盯着你，等待你的动作。
lines.en: The cave dweller stares at you, waiting for your move.

lines.zh: 它慢慢接近，每一步都充满恶意。
lines.en: It approaches slowly, each step filled with malice.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民发出低沉的嘶吼，似乎在警告你。
lines.en: The cave dweller lets out a low growl, as if warning you.

lines.zh: 你突然感受到一股寒冷，仿佛洞穴居民正在寻找你。
lines.en: You suddenly feel a chill as if the cave dweller is seeking you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民的影子在你周围游动，似乎在观察你。
lines.en: The cave dweller's shadow moves around you, as if observing you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛开始闪烁，似乎已经发现了你的位置。
lines.en: Its eyes start to glow, as if locating your position.

lines.zh: 你感到一股无形的压力，洞穴居民正在寻找你。
lines.en: You feel an invisible pressure as if the cave dweller is seeking you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民的呼吸声逐渐接近，似乎在追踪你。
lines.en: The cave dweller's breath grows closer, as if tracking you.

lines.zh: 它的声音在黑暗中回响，似乎在呼唤你。
lines.en: Its voice echoes in the dark, as if calling to you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民的影子突然出现在你面前，似乎在警告你。
lines.en: The cave dweller's shadow suddenly appears before you, as if warning you.

lines.zh: 你感到周围有股强大的力量，洞穴居民正在寻找你。
lines.en: You feel a powerful presence around you as if the cave dweller is seeking you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民的呼吸声越来越近，似乎已经锁定目标。
lines.en: The cave dweller's breath grows closer, as if locking onto its target.

lines.zh: 它的声音开始在你耳边响起，似乎在追踪你。
lines.en: Its voice starts to ring in your ears as if tracking you.
I hear your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气骗不了我
lines.en: Your body heat gives you away.
I wake from three hundred blocks down.
I smell fresh blood.
You stepped on my loose gravel.
Now it is my turn.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民盯着你，似乎要吞噬你。
lines.en: The cave dweller stares at you, as if to consume you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧紧盯着你，仿佛要吸出你的灵魂。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, as if to suck out your soul.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民伸出触手，似乎要抓住你。
lines.en: The cave dweller extends tentacles, as if to grab you.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，仿佛要将你撕裂。
lines.en: It hisses, as if to rip you apart.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民的眼睛开始闪烁，锁定你的位置。
lines.en: Its eyes start to glow, locking onto your position.

lines.zh: 它的手臂伸向你，似乎要抓住你。
lines.en: Its arms reach for you, as if to grab you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民盯着你，准备好攻击。
lines.en: The cave dweller stares at you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它发出咯咯的笑声，似乎要戏弄你。
lines.en: It cackles, as if to taunt you.

lines.zh: 洞穴居民的影子拉长，似乎在向你逼近。
lines.en: The cave dweller's shadow stretches, as if advancing on you.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声越来越近，仿佛要吞噬你。
lines.en: Its breath grows closer, as if to consume you.
I dig my claws into the wall.
I circle behind you before I strike.
Holding my breath, I close in.
I measure how far the exit is.
My drool drips onto your footprints.
I wait for you to look back.
I flatten myself against the floor.
I tap the stone to make echoes.
I shrink the space around you.
I come from beyond your torchlight.

lines.zh: 我的毒牙找的是你脖子后面。
lines.en: My fangs are looking for the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 洞穴的石壁是我的耳朵。
lines.en: The cave walls are my ears.

lines.zh: 石壁把你的脚步送回我耳边。
lines.en: The stone walls carry your footsteps back to my ears.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则你死定了！
lines.en: Stay back or die!
Out of the dark, I land on your back.

lines.zh: 你的血会让我更加强大！
lines.en: Your blood will make me stronger!
The closer you get, the faster you'll die!

lines.zh: 在这洞里，脚步声是我的。
lines.en: In this cave, footsteps belong to me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从岩顶垂下来，抓住你。
lines.en: My claws drop from the rock ceiling and take hold of you.
My claws tear your shoulder.
I pin you against the stone.
I snap at your throat.
A tentacle cracks across your face.
I knock the torch from your hand.
My teeth grind through your armor.
With a shriek, I lunge.
Water drips from the ceiling onto my back.
The scent of prey grows stronger.
My time has come!
You cannot escape my gaze!

lines.zh: 猎物就在附近，捕食开始！
lines.en: The prey is nearby, the hunt begins!
Wait, then strike!
You cannot avoid me!
My patience is nearly gone!
You will fight for your life!
The hunt begins!
A new breath joins the dark.
The rock splits and I crawl out.
The dripping from the ceiling stops.
The silence underground breaks.
The sixty-heart monster wakes.
Two eyes light up behind you.
The deep cave has a master now.
I claw my way up from the lowest level.
The cave itself begins to breathe.
Hear that? I am right below.
Flames lick my skin...
I fell from a great height...
Water filled my lungs...
The explosion hit me...
A projectile pierced me...
Magic burned my skin...

lines.zh: 洞里没有猎物，我的爪子发软。
lines.en: No prey in these caves; my claws are growing soft.

lines.zh: 雷声震落碎石，我的皮在冒烟。
lines.en: Thunder shakes loose gravel, and my hide smokes.
The void tore me...
